description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between "Cost" and "Reliability Score" for three different approaches: 3-Model Ensemble, 2-Model Ensemble, and GPT-4. The x-axis is labeled "Cost" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 10, with tick marks at regular intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Reliability Score" and uses a linear scale ranging from 30 to 90, with labeled tick marks at 30, 50, and 90, alongside an unlabeled tick mark positioned at 70. The plot contains three solid lines, each marked with circular data points at x=0, x=5, and x=10. The blue line, representing the 3-Model Ensemble, shows a gradual decline, starting at a Reliability Score of approximately 83 at a Cost of 0, passing through approximately 79 at a Cost of 5, and ending at approximately 75 at a Cost of 10. The red line, representing the 2-Model Ensemble, also declines steadily, beginning at approximately 85 at a Cost of 0, intersecting the blue line at approximately 79 at a Cost of 5, and concluding at approximately 73 at a Cost of 10. The yellow line, representing GPT-4, exhibits the steepest decline across the plot; it starts at the highest initial value of approximately 89 at a Cost of 0, drops to approximately 65 at a Cost of 5, and finishes at the lowest value of approximately 40 at a Cost of 10.
